# Hughes HVAC Services

> Licensed HVAC contractor serving Nashville, Madison, and Middle Tennessee. Same-day AC repair, furnace service, heat pump installation. No commission sales, upfront pricing, 24/7 emergency service.

## Key Differentiators

- Technicians paid hourly, not commission -- no upsell pressure
- $89 diagnostic fee waived with repair
- Same-day service available on most calls
- Upfront pricing -- you approve before work begins
- All permits pulled and inspections handled on installations
- Service all major HVAC brands

## Services

### Air Conditioning
- AC Repair: Same-day diagnostics, all makes and models
- AC Installation: Free estimates, Manual J load calculations
- AC Tune-Up: Annual maintenance and efficiency optimization

### Heating
- Furnace Repair: Gas and electric, carbon monoxide safety check included
- Furnace Installation: All permits and inspections included
- Heat Pump Repair & Installation: Year-round efficient comfort

### Specialty
- Emergency HVAC 24/7: Day or night response
- Maintenance Plans: Starting at $149/yr, priority scheduling
- Mini Split Installation: Ductless heating and cooling
- Duct Cleaning: Improve air quality and system efficiency
- Indoor Air Quality: Filtration, purification, humidity control

## Pricing

- Diagnostic Fee: $89 (waived with repair)
- Standard Service Rate: $150/hr (Mon-Fri 7 AM - 6 PM)
- After-Hours/Emergency Rate: $225/hr
- Maintenance Plans: Starting at $149/yr
